name: savvy-progress
description: Progress bar above the prompt for /savvy-flow, plus an agents panel (/agents-info): running, finished and planned subagents with model, task progress, context, cost and time.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale

animation.title: Terminal animation
animation.description: on animates the crabs and the bar in the terminal; off draws them still

panel.title: Agents panel
panel.description: manual opens the panel only on /agents-info; auto also opens it when a savvy-flow plan or worker starts
